title: Chromosome 6 — one band deleted
clinical_history: Compare this chromosome 6 map with a normal chromosome 6. Band 6q21 has been removed. Neighboring bands stay in order. This is a schematic teaching deletion, not a disease case.
hints: A deletion removes material. The bands on either side stay in their original order.
The missing band is on the long arm. The short arm and the centromere are unchanged.
This map is a teaching deletion of 6q21. It is not one of the disease cases.
explanation: The teaching map removes segment 6q21 and leaves the rest of chromosome 6 in order. That is an interstitial deletion, written del(6)(q21). No syndrome is attached to this exercise.
plain_language_interpretation: Chromosome 6 is missing band 6q21. The rest of the chromosome is unchanged.
